Any Nix package, live in your browser
item.description: tl;dr Try it at https://trynix.dev. Click hello, or python 3.6.2 from 2017, or two eras of hello at once, or a package that exists in no public cache. A Linux machine boots in the tab and you get a shell with those Nix packages on PATH. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Particle Charts: Render Charts as Clouds of Particles
item.description: A zero-dependency JavaScript charting library that renders bar, line, bubble, radar, pie and donut charts as living clouds of particles. 20 kB, responsive, accessible and typed. (1 source: frontendfocus)
